Twitch occasionally offers item rewards in World of Warcraft as Twitch drops or as part of the Amazon Prime membership. Twitch drops are items that unlock for viewers of eligible channels on the streaming site after watching for a certain amount of time. While some Blizzard games such as Overwatch have already gotten Twitch drops or Amazon Prime rewards before, World of Warcraft didn't start this until 2022. This article is meant to show the history of past and current Twitch-related goodies for the Warcraft franchise.

GameTooltip (inherits from ) formats a tooltip. There is one named _G["GameTooltip"], but others are created with or . Custom tooltips made in Lua must inherit a virtual XML template: * SharedTooltipTemplate - Includes base font strings and textures. * GameTooltipTemplate - Additionally includes a unit health bar. Alternatively, see for minimum requirements in XML. __FORCETOC__

SimpleHTML widgets allow display of simple HTML markup as well as standard escape sequences. The two may be combined; if HTML is not valid (not well-formed XHTML), it will be displayed literaly. SimpleHTML inherits from FontInstance, but there's a difference in that methods have an optional first parameter for which element's font to set (h1, h2, p, etc). The FontInstance methods are not reflected in the SimpleHTML frame until you SetText on the frame. It also appears that you can only supply the block elements and not the inline elements (ie Hyperlinks cannot be colored a different color). Other than that, see FontInstance for documentation of these methods.

AlphaMode can take the following values: * DISABLE - opaque texture * BLEND - normal painting on top of the background, obeying alpha channels if present in the image (uses alpha) * ALPHAKEY - one-bit alpha * ADD - additive blend * MOD - modulating blend

EditBox (inherits from and ) is an interactive text field for keyboard input. A user can input text into the edit box which can then be retrieved using the EditBox:GetText() function. When declaring an edit box object make sure that you either set "font" attribute for <EditBox> element, or include a <FontString> element, thus declaring which font is to be used to display text input into your edit box. If you do not do so EditBox will not display any text, just a blinking cursor. .. Size .. Anchors .. Layers .. etc.

Scaling shrinks or expands the user interface. Instead of pixels, lengths measure in scaled units equal to 1/768 of the screen height multiplied by a ratio. For measuring a point on the screen, this ratio is 1.0. For measuring widgets, this ratio is usually the UI Scale that is user-configurable in the System settings.

ScrollFrame (inherits from ) may be customized to vertically or horizontally scroll other widgets. The logic and textures to operate the ScrollFrame may be inherited from a template: * UIPanelScrollFrameCodeTemplate - The logic for vertial scrolling without any textures. * UIPanelScrollFrameTemplate - Adds vertical scroll bar textures beyond the right edge of the ScrollFrame. * FauxScrollFrameTemplate - Adds vertical scroll bar textures but without logic to move the child frame. * HybridScrollFrameTemplate - Reuses child widgets by passing them a new ID to display different list entries.

With the low barrier to entry, writing mods has become very popular. While this has greatly benefited the WoW community, it does have a dark side. There are idiosyncrasies in both the Lua language and the World of Warcraft API that many authors overlook. This can lead to poorly written programs as measured by performance, memory usage, interference with other addons and the default UI, etc. The techniques gathering on this page will help help addon authors, experienced and otherwise, make the most out of WoW's environment safely and efficiently.

UI Scale is an option in the Main Menu, within "Video Options" under "Resolution", to adjust the UI scaling applied to most widgets in the user interface. A checkbox enables the feature, and a slider sets the custom value starting from a minimum range of 0.64. 1.0 causes most widgets to scale as if the screen were 768 units tall. Disabling the checkbox allows the game chooses a default scale that between 0.64 and 1.00 for Retail, or between 0.90 and 1.00 for Classic.

Tyrhold, originally known as Uldorus, is a titan facility atop the Halls of Infusion in Thaldraszus in the Dragon Isles. Tyr named it "Uldorus", but the dragons started calling it "Tyrhold" and the name stuck, much to Tyr's embarrassment. The Beacon of Tyrhold, at the top, was used long ago to conceal them from the rest of the world. Beneath Tyrhold is the Wellspring of Eternity, where Azeroth's lifeblood comes to the surface. ScriptObject is an abstract widget type that provides support for widget scripts. Scripts can be set to trigger in response to some widget event, or as a result of user interaction. The specific scripts that are supported vary wildly from object to object, but all objects support setting, hooking and getting of object scripts.

LayeredRegion (inherits from ) is an abstract widget type that groups together the functionality of layered graphical regions: Textures, FontStrings, Lines and MaskTextures. Uldum (pronounced: ) is an ancient desert located on the southern coast of Kalimdor, surrounded by the Un'Goro Crater in the north, Tanaris in the east and Silithus in the northwest. It is the homeland of stone-cat people known as tol'vir and is rich with titan lore. A superweapon is rumored to exist in Uldum which the Alliance, Horde and Deathwing's minions seek. There is no super weapon, however; Uldum is the weapon, intended to wipe out all life on Azeroth in case Algalon the Observer's Reply-Code Omega went through to the titans.

Ulduar () is the biggest titan-forged complex on Azeroth. Perfectly preserved in the snows of the Storm Peaks, it was once thought to house fabled treasures and relics along with its great engines of creation, in reality, it was conceived first and foremost as a prison for the Old God Yogg-Saron. It notably encompasses the Halls of Stone, the Temple of Wisdom, the Halls of Lightning, and the prison of the Old God Yogg-Saron. The Halls of Valor were a section of Ulduar until Helya ripped, and stationed them in the misty heavens above Azeroth.

Ug'thor Bloodfrenzy, called Ug by his father, is the orc son of Warden Nork Bloodfrenzy found outside Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. While looking at the Alliance Deserters his father asked him if he what they were. Having never seen a human before Ug'thor asked if they were pigs and when informed by his father that they are cowards he asks if they are cowardly pigs. With a shake of his head Nork tells his son that they are soldiers of the Alliance, the Horde's sworn enemy. Ug'thor is then told by his father that the deserters are afraid to die, a concept which confuses him. The Umbrafen is a mushroom marsh in northeast , bordered and largely hemmed in to the southeast by Elodor. There are ogre ruins buried here. A few quests take place here and there are a couple of vignettes present: *Ba'ruun *Mushroom-Covered Chest *Strange Spore
Ulduar Colossus are iron giants found throughout the Iron Concourse in Ulduar.

Uda the Beast is a Mag'har orc innkeeper for The Filthy Animal inn located in the Sunreaver's Sanctuary within Dalaran. She does not want fighting within her inn or she will feed the culpable to her wolves, Nargut and Rhukah.
Ultimate Triage was a profession achievement earned by using a Heavy Frostweave Bandage, or any Embersilk Bandage or Windwool Bandage, to heal a player who has less than 5% health.
Uldum Chest Key Code drops from Schnottz Air Officers in Uldum.

Ufuda Giant-Slayer was an elite level 90 Strand of the Ancients battlemaster located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar during the Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients. She was only available during the monthly (Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients).
The Umbriss Band is a ring that drops from General Umbriss in Grim Batol.
The Uldaman Entrance Digsite is the area surrounding the entrance to Uldaman and a dwarf archaeology dig site. Numerous Dark Iron dwarves can be found excavating here.

Umbrage for Umbriss is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating General Umbriss while he is affected with Modgud's Malice in Grim Batol on Heroic difficulty.
Umi is a level 83 tol'vir fruit vendor located in Mar'at of Uldum. He is a silent NPC who doesn't speak even when clicked.
__NOTOC__ Umboda Three-Heads is a forest troll found in Jintha'Alor of the Hinterlands.
Umboda's Head drops from Umboda Three-Heads in the Hinterlands.
Uldaman Guild Run is a guild achievement that is awarded for defeating the final boss of the Uldaman instance while in a guild group.

The Umbrella of Chi-Ji is a rare pandaren archaeology artifact, created from 180 Pandaren Archaeology Fragment. Up to three Pandaren Pottery Shard may be used to solve this artifact.
Uigi is a fox located just outside the Tavern in the Mists in the Veiled Stair. It is running after Makkie.
__NOTOC__ Umbraglow Stingers are fireflies found in Zangarmarsh.
Ultramus is a level 16 miniature abyssal battle pet belonging to Zoltan.
Ubunti the Shade is one of three Horde champions at Domination Point in southwestern Krasarang Wilds. He spawns inside the south tower on the beach every 45 minutes to an hour.

__NOTOC__ Ukos Bloodwhisper is an orc who can be found in the Drag, just outside the Transmogrification station. It appears that he is rifling through the mail box, as if he is looking for something. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. Ukos was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar, initially standing next to Tactical Officer Kilrath.
Uchek is a jungle troll located at the Glopgut's Hollow in the Twilight Highlands. He sends you to the spirit world during Night Terrors (quest).
Udoho Icerunner is the stable master for Camp Tunka'lo in the Storm Peaks.
Ulmaas' Robes of Crushing Magma are a possible drop from Ordos, the world boss yaungol on the Timeless Isle.
